items.title: 给 finding 加 suspected/verified/disproven 证据状态模型
items.context: bug 通道有 repro 加 rootCause 加 reproTest 才能标 fixed 的硬纪律，finding 通道没有等价物。给 finding 加一个证据状态字段（suspected / verified / disproven），规则：未复现或无源码证据的 finding 只能是 suspected，不能呈现成 confirmed bug；disproven 时必须保留反证摘要。现有 finding 无该字段时视为 legacy 兼容处理。
items.userSees: 用户跑 `koala finding_list` 时每条 finding 显示 `evidenceState=suspected|verified|disproven`；一条 suspected 的 critical finding 进 review summary 的 advisory/attention 区而非 blocking 区，`story_advance --phase=TEST` 不被它挡；只有 evidenceState=verified 且 status=open 的 critical/high finding 才挡。

happy.desc: legacy finding (critical, open, no evidenceState field) -> gate blocks REVIEW->TEST; WHY: backward compat guarantee that missing evidenceState is treated as verified
reviewer finding_add with critical severity (no explicit evidenceState) -> defaults to verified -> gate blocks REVIEW->TEST; WHY: confirm new findings keep existing gate behavior

reviewer finding_add with critical severity + explicit evidenceState=suspected + uncertaintyReason provided -> gate does NOT block REVIEW->TEST, finding_list shows it in advisory/attention section; WHY: core value proposition of the story
finding with evidenceState=verified + severity=critical + status=resolved -> gate does NOT block; WHY: resolved findings regardless of evidenceState must not block
finding with evidenceState=disproven + severity=critical + status=open -> gate does NOT block; WHY: disproven findings must never block even when still open
finding_list output includes evidenceState field for every finding (verified/suspected/disproven/absent shows as legacy); WHY: observability requirement from userSees

finding_add with explicit evidenceState=suspected but missing uncertaintyReason -> handler throws clear error, finding not written; WHY: prevent abusing suspected as gate-bypass button without justification

edge.desc: finding with evidenceState=verified + severity=high + status=dismissed -> gate does NOT block; WHY: dismissed overrides severity regardless of evidenceState
finding with evidenceState=suspected + severity=medium + status=open -> gate does NOT block even in Round 1; WHY: suspected medium is doubly non-blocking (suspected + not critical/high)
finding_add with evidenceState=disproven but missing disprovenEvidence summary -> handler rejects; WHY: constraint requires disproven must carry counter-evidence
mix of legacy findings (no evidenceState) + new findings (with evidenceState) in same story -> gate correctly evaluates each independently; WHY: migration coexistence
finding_add with invalid evidenceState value (e.g. confirmed) -> Zod rejects + handler runtime rejects; WHY: enum hardening per Handler coding convention

adversarial.desc: agent sets all critical findings to suspected with minimal 1-char uncertaintyReason to bypass gate -> handler enforces uncertaintyReason minimum length (>=10 chars); WHY: prevent trivial reason as gate bypass

agent directly edits findings.json to remove evidenceState from a verified finding -> gate re-reads from disk treats missing field as verified (legacy compat), still blocks; WHY: file tampering must not open escape hatch

agent calls finding_add with evidenceState=suspected on a finding that was previously verified (downgrade attack) -> handler rejects downgrade without structured justification; WHY: prevent weaponizing state transitions
concurrent finding_add: two findings same story, one verified critical + one suspected critical -> gate blocks on the verified one only; WHY: partial suspected must not mask real blockers

items.title: 补框架 gap 的手动归档入口
items.context: 人工发现的框架 gap 目前只能滥用 reviewer 形状的 finding_add（要 reviewRunId、category enum、review round 语义）。需要一个不依赖 reviewer / review round / worktree 的手动归档入口，让框架 gap 能进 audit backlog 并带上 CHK-001 的证据状态。B-META 容器与该入口的关系、是否复用既有 audit-meta-store 在 PLAN 阶段定。
items.userSees: agent 跑 `koala gap_log` 看到 `Gap logged: B-META-framework-audit:F-00X (evidenceState=suspected, severity=...)`；缺 category/severity/evidence/source 任一字段时报明确错误；B-META 容器不存在时自动 bootstrap，无需 story worktree。

happy.desc: koala gap_log with all required fields (category, severity, evidence, source) -> output Gap logged: B-META-framework-audit:F-00X (evidenceState=suspected, severity=<val>); WHY: primary command happy path
B-META-framework-audit container does not exist before first gap_log call -> gap_log auto-bootstraps via ensureMetaStory, finding written successfully; WHY: zero-setup requirement
gap_log called from main branch (no story worktree) -> succeeds; WHY: worktree-independence requirement
gap_log default evidenceState is suspected when no structured evidence fields provided; WHY: constraint that gap_log defaults suspected
gap_log with structured evidence fields (sourceRefs + reproCommand) + explicit evidenceState=verified -> accepted and stored as verified; WHY: verified path requires structured evidence

edge.desc: gap_log missing category field -> clear error message, no finding written; WHY: field completeness gate
gap_log missing severity field -> clear error message, no finding written; WHY: field completeness gate
gap_log missing evidence field -> clear error message, no finding written; WHY: field completeness gate
gap_log missing source field -> clear error message, no finding written; WHY: field completeness gate
gap_log called twice with identical content -> second call creates separate finding (not deduplicated, unlike audit drift upsert); WHY: manual archival is intentionally non-deduped
gap_log with severity value outside canonical enum (e.g. urgent) -> Zod + handler runtime reject; WHY: enum hardening
B-META-framework-audit already exists with prior findings -> gap_log appends new finding, prior findings untouched; WHY: idempotent container, additive writes

adversarial.desc: gap_log with evidenceState=verified but NO structured evidence fields (no sourceRefs, no reproCommand, no observedOutput, no analysisNote) -> handler forces evidenceState back to suspected; WHY: constraint that verified requires structured evidence
gap_log with evidenceState=disproven -> rejected (gap_log is for archiving suspected gaps, not for recording disproof); WHY: disproven semantic does not apply to manual gap archival entry point
gap_log with empty-string evidence field (whitespace only) -> handler rejects, treats as missing; WHY: prevent garbage entries in B-META
gap_log called in rapid succession (5 calls <1s) with different content -> all 5 findings written, no race condition on findings.json; WHY: concurrent write safety
gap_log command registered in registry.ts and command-policy.ts with correct allowedPhases policy -> koala help shows gap_log; WHY: command discoverability

items.title: 更新 process fact registry 与 contract 校验脚本加文档
items.context: 证据状态若被任何门禁或 audit 消费就是流程事实，必须同步 process-fact-registry 与对应 contract 校验脚本（按 CLAUDE.md 流程事实双层契约要求）。文档说明证据状态模型与手动归档入口的用法。
items.userSees: `node scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs` 通过，evidenceState 流程事实与 gap_log 命令已登记进 process-fact-registry；AGENTS.md 有 evidenceState 模型与 gap_log 用法说明。

happy.desc: node scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs exits 0 after CHK-001+CHK-002 landed -> evidenceState and gap_log are registered as process facts; WHY: contract script must pass
process-fact-registry.ts contains evidenceState entry with gate-consumed semantic marker; WHY: evidenceState is consumed by REVIEW->TEST gate
process-fact-registry.ts contains gap_log command entry; WHY: new command must be registered
AGENTS.md contains evidenceState default table (reviewer=verified, gap_log=suspected, legacy=verified compat); WHY: documentation requirement from userSees
AGENTS.md contains gap_log usage instructions (required fields, example invocation); WHY: documentation requirement

edge.desc: verify-process-fact-contract.mjs fails if evidenceState entry is removed from registry -> non-zero exit; WHY: contract script must detect regressions
verify-process-fact-contract.mjs fails if gap_log entry is removed from registry -> non-zero exit; WHY: contract script must detect regressions
AGENTS.md documents gate predicate formula (status=open AND severity in critical/high AND evidenceState=verified or null); WHY: gate behavior must be documented precisely

adversarial.desc: remove evidenceState from guard-utils.ts blocking filter but keep registry entry -> contract script detects mismatch (hardcoded fallback missing) and fails; WHY: dual-layer contract requires both prompt guidance AND code fallback
add evidenceState to registry but with wrong semantic type (e.g. informational instead of gate-consumed) -> contract script detects semantic mismatch; WHY: registry accuracy matters for audit
AGENTS.md mentions gap_log but with wrong required fields list -> manual review catch (contract script validates registry not docs prose); WHY: docs drift detection boundary
